title: Halloween Special | COPICafe Episode 29 | Cornucopias
description:
Cornucopias Racing League Q&A with David, Creative Director

In this episode of COPICafe, Josh shows off his blue-collar trucker accent and Rob has fallen to  the dark side of the force. Josh & Rob keep us up to date on the latest with the Chainport Bridge and when to expect an announcement. Josh outlines steps Cornucopias is taking to become competitive employer in the game development industry. The guys announce a new hire that will be joining the team shortly. Josh & Rob welcome David, the creative director of Cornucopias to answer questions from the community surrounding the Cornucopias Racing League. And of course, don't miss the leak at the end of the episode.

Post your contest entries for this episode into the "Word Game" channel in Discord. 

00:00 - Introduction
01.50 - Beverage Choices
02:54 - Chainport Bridge Update
04:44 - Employer Wellness Program
05:35 - New Hire - React Developer
06:38 - Website Update
08:16 - Special Guest: David - Creative Director
09:25 - David's Role at Cornucopias
10:40 - David's Impressions of cNFTcon
13:07 - Community Questions
30:00 - LEAK

Other MUST-SEE videos: 
PVP Gameplay: https://youtu.be/Gtw3qAgaXYI 
Custom Dome Tour: https://youtu.be/aL_4dTFKyJk 
Solace Teaser: https://youtu.be/v52pdDdPzMw

#Metaverse #Cardano #CryptoCurrency #Blockchain #NFT #MetaverseGame #iohk 

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
